layout_sources: https://github.com/redstreet/beancount_reds_importers/blob/main/beancount_reds_importers/importers/unitedoverseas/uobbank.py (file ACC_TXN_History*.xls read with xlrd; first cell "United Overseas Bank Limited", then "Account Type:" "Uniplus Account"; header "Transaction Date,Transaction Description,Withdrawal,Deposit,Available Balance"; %d %b %Y; descriptions hold line breaks; 0 in the unused money column; currency is the third cell of the "Account Number:" row; the first line is the newest)

https://github.com/bank2ynab/bank2ynab/blob/develop/bank2ynab/data/bank2ynab.conf ([SG UOB Savings Account]: ACC_TXN_History_<14 digits>.xls, Header Rows = 8, %d %b %Y, read through its xls_converter plugin)
notes: UOB Personal Internet Banking account history is an old-style Excel 97-2003 workbook (BIFF8 .xls), not CSV or .xlsx. Seven rows above the table (bank name, account type, account number with the currency in the third cell, the period, blank rows), the header on row 8, then lines newest first: date as text "28 Oct 2026", a multi-line description, Withdrawal and Deposit as numbers with 0 in the unused one, the Available Balance after the line. The "Statement Period:" wording and which preamble rows are blank are unconfirmed. Written with xlwt 1.3.0.
